action.zh-CN: 自定义消息操作栏的 snippet，参数含默认按钮数组 `defaultActions`、按名称索引的 `defaultActionsObj`、消息 `message` 与 `class`；按钮不显示时（如消息未完成）对应的键不存在。
action.en-US: Snippet for a custom action bar, with the default buttons `defaultActions`, the same buttons by name `defaultActionsObj`, the message and `class`. A key is missing when its button is not shown, for example while the message is unfinished.

align.zh-CN: 对话布局方式，可选 leftRight（左右分布）或 leftAlign（左对齐）。

avatar.zh-CN: 自定义头像的 snippet，参数含默认头像 `defaultAvatar`、消息 `message` 与角色 `role`。
avatar.en-US: Snippet for a custom avatar, with the default avatar `defaultAvatar`, the message and the role.

chats.zh-CN: 对话消息列表，可用 `bind:chats` 双向绑定。不绑定时，组件内的增删改（如删除消息）只在组件内生效；`onChatsChange` 在每次变更时只调用一次。
chats.en-US: List of conversation messages; bind it with `bind:chats`. Without a binding, changes made inside the component (such as deleting a message) stay local to it; `onChatsChange` is called once per change.

content.zh-CN: 自定义内容区域的 snippet，参数含默认内容 `defaultContent`、消息 `message`、角色 `role` 与 `class`。`defaultContent` 与默认渲染一致，包含引用列表与加载指示。
content.en-US: Snippet for a custom content area, with the default content `defaultContent`, the message, the role and `class`. `defaultContent` matches the default rendering, including the reference list and the loading indicator.

contentItem.zh-CN: 按内容项自定义渲染的 snippet，每个内容项都会先经过它，参数含 `item`、`type`、`message`、`index`、`parent`、默认渲染 `defaultItem` 与自定义节点应带的 `class`。snippet 的输出无法检查，不处理的项需自己用 `{@render defaultItem()}` 渲染，渲染为空时不会回落到内置渲染。
contentItem.en-US: Snippet for custom rendering by content item. Every item passes through it first, with `item`, `type`, `message`, `index`, `parent`, the built-in rendering `defaultItem` and the `class` a custom node should carry. A snippet's output cannot be inspected, so render the items it leaves alone with `{@render defaultItem()}`; empty output does not fall back to the built-in rendering.

disabledFileItemClick.zh-CN: 是否禁用文件卡片的点击。
disabledFileItemClick.en-US: Whether clicking a file card is disabled.

escapeHtml.zh-CN: 是否转义用户消息中的 HTML 标签，避免被 Markdown 解析器当作 HTML 处理而丢失内容。
escapeHtml.en-US: Whether to escape HTML tags in user messages, so the Markdown parser does not treat them as HTML and drop content.

fullDialogue.zh-CN: 完全自定义整条对话的 snippet，参数含 `defaultNodes`（avatar、title、content、action）、消息 `message`、角色 `role` 与 `class`。
fullDialogue.en-US: Snippet that replaces a whole dialogue, with `defaultNodes` (avatar, title, content, action), the message, the role and `class`.

hintBox.zh-CN: 自定义提示项的 snippet，参数含提示文本 `content`、序号 `index` 与点击回调 `onHintClick`。
hintBox.en-US: Snippet for a custom hint item, with the hint text `content`, the index and the click callback `onHintClick`.

hintCls.en-US: Class name of the outermost hint area element.

hints.zh-CN: 提示信息。点击某条提示后，它成为新的用户消息，并触发 onHintClick。
hints.en-US: Hint texts. Clicking a hint turns it into a new user message and calls onHintClick.

hintStyle.zh-CN: 提示区最外层的样式字符串。
hintStyle.en-US: Style string of the outermost hint area element.

markdownRenderProps.zh-CN: 透传给每条消息所用 MarkdownRender 的属性，raw 由消息决定，不可传入；components 与内置组件合并，同名的（如 code）覆盖内置组件。
markdownRenderProps.en-US: Props passed to the MarkdownRender of each message. raw is decided by the message and cannot be passed; components are merged with the built-in ones, and a component with the same name (such as code) replaces the built-in one.

messageEdit.zh-CN: 用户消息处于编辑状态时显示的编辑器 snippet，参数为消息转换得到的输入内容。
messageEdit.en-US: Snippet for the editor shown while a user message is being edited; its parameters are the input content converted from the message.

messageText.zh-CN: 替换内容为纯文本的消息的 Markdown 渲染的 snippet，参数含文本 `text` 与消息 `message`。
messageText.en-US: Snippet that replaces the Markdown rendering of a message whose content is plain text, with the `text` and the `message`.

mode.zh-CN: 对话模式，可选 bubble、noBubble 或 userBubble。
mode.en-US: Conversation mode: bubble, noBubble or userBubble.

onAnnotationClick.zh-CN: 点击参考来源时的回调，参数为被点击消息块的注释数组。
onAnnotationClick.en-US: Called when the references of a message block are clicked, with that block's annotations.

onChatsChange.zh-CN: 消息列表变化时的回调，参数为新的消息数组。
onChatsChange.en-US: Called when the message list changes, with the new message array.

onFileClick.zh-CN: 点击文件卡片时的回调。
onFileClick.en-US: Called when a file card is clicked.

onHintClick.zh-CN: 点击提示词时的回调，参数为被点击的提示文本。
onHintClick.en-US: Called when a hint is clicked, with the hint text.

onImageClick.en-US: Called when an image is clicked.

onMessageBadFeedback.en-US: Called when a message is disliked.

onMessageCopy.zh-CN: 复制消息时的回调：文本写入剪贴板成功后才调用，复制的文本不含推理内容；没有可复制的文本时既不写入也不调用。
onMessageCopy.en-US: Called when a message is copied, after the text has been written to the clipboard successfully. The copied text excludes reasoning; a message without text is neither written nor reported.

onMessageDelete.en-US: Called when a message is deleted.

onMessageEdit.en-US: Called when a message is edited.

onMessageGoodFeedback.en-US: Called when a message is liked.

onMessageReset.en-US: Called when a message is reset.

onMessageShare.en-US: Called when a message is shared.

onReferenceClick.zh-CN: 点击引用按钮时的回调。参数没有 id，加入 AIChatInput 的 references 前由使用方补上；文件项没有 type。
onReferenceClick.en-US: Called when a reference button is clicked. The argument has no id, which the caller adds before putting it into the references of AIChatInput; a file item has no type.

onSelect.zh-CN: 选中的消息变化时的回调，参数为选中消息的 id 数组。
onSelect.en-US: Called when the selected messages change, with the ids of the selected messages.

roleConfig.zh-CN: 各角色（user、assistant、system 等）的名称、头像与头像颜色，必填，不读取全局默认值。
roleConfig.en-US: Name, avatar and avatar color of each role (user, assistant, system and so on). Required; the global defaults are not read.

showReference.zh-CN: 是否在文字或文件消息中展示可被引用的图标，仅对用户消息生效。
showReference.en-US: Whether to show the quote icon on text or file messages; it only applies to user messages.

showReset.en-US: Whether to show the reset action.

title.zh-CN: 自定义标题的 snippet，参数含默认标题 `defaultTitle`、消息 `message` 与角色 `role`。
title.en-US: Snippet for a custom title, with the default title `defaultTitle`, the message and the role.

scrollToBottom.zh-CN: 滚动到最底部，参数为 true 时带动画。
scrollToBottom.en-US: Scrolls to the bottom, animated when the argument is true.

scrollToTop.zh-CN: 滚动到最顶部，参数为 true 时带动画。
scrollToTop.en-US: Scrolls to the top, animated when the argument is true.

children.zh-CN: 替换推理正文 Markdown 渲染的 snippet（`content` 已是推理数据的属性名，所以正文 snippet 叫 `children`），参数为 `status`、`summary`、`content` 与 `markdownRenderProps`。
children.en-US: Snippet that replaces the Markdown rendering of the reasoning text (`content` is already the reasoning data, so the body snippet is `children`), with `status`, `summary`, `content` and `markdownRenderProps`.

content.zh-CN: 推理内容，summary 为空时按换行拼接其中的文本作为推理正文。
content.en-US: Reasoning content. When summary is empty, its texts joined by line breaks form the reasoning text.

markdownRenderProps.zh-CN: 透传给推理正文所用 MarkdownRender 的属性，raw 由推理正文决定。
markdownRenderProps.en-US: Props passed to the MarkdownRender of the reasoning text; raw comes from the reasoning text.

status.zh-CN: 推理状态。为 completed 时标题显示已完成，且初次渲染时折叠；其他值显示思考中并展开。
status.en-US: Reasoning status. completed shows the finished title and starts collapsed; any other value shows the thinking title and starts expanded.

summary.zh-CN: 推理摘要，非空时按换行拼接其中的文本作为推理正文。
summary.en-US: Reasoning summary. When it is not empty, its texts joined by line breaks form the reasoning text.

actionIcon.zh-CN: 显示在每个操作描述前的图标 snippet，参数为操作 `item`、序号 `index`、所属步骤 `step` 与步骤序号 `stepIndex`。
actionIcon.en-US: Snippet for the icon shown before each action's description, with the action `item`, its `index`, the `step` it belongs to and `stepIndex`.

steps.zh-CN: 步骤列表。每个步骤含 summary、status 与 actions，status 为 completed 时显示完成图标，否则显示加载中；actions 只放数据（summary、description 等），步骤可点击或用 Enter、空格展开收起。
steps.en-US: List of steps. Each step has summary, status and actions; completed shows the done icon, any other status shows loading. actions hold data only (summary, description and so on), and a step expands or collapses on click, Enter or Space.

annotation.zh-CN: 参考来源列表，每项可含 title、logo、url、detail。
annotation.en-US: List of references; each item may have title, logo, url and detail.

description.zh-CN: 来源图标后的描述文字，不传时显示来源数量。
description.en-US: Text after the source logos; the number of references is shown when it is not set.

maxCount.zh-CN: 最多显示的来源图标数，超出部分显示为 +N。
maxCount.en-US: Maximum number of source logos shown; the rest are shown as +N.

onClick.zh-CN: 点击或用 Enter、空格激活时的回调，参数为原生事件与参考来源列表。
onClick.en-US: Called on click or on activation with Enter or Space, with the native event and the references.
